optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Capacity Planning Analyst, Wealth Services Platform

professionalSummary.text: Maintains the month-end demand model that forecasts batch volume from client, account and report counts, refreshing coefficients quarterly from platform job-history tables.
professionalSummary.witness: Maintained the month-end demand model that forecasts batch volume from client, account and report counts, refreshing the coefficients each quarter from the platform's job-history tables.

professionalSummary.text: Plans compute and storage capacity for month-end cycles with the platform team, translating forecasts into node reservations and storage headroom in capacity plans.
professionalSummary.witness: Planned compute and storage for each month-end cycle with the platform team, translating the forecast into node reservations and storage headroom in the capacity plan.

professionalSummary.text: Reduces month-end batch overruns from 9 to 2 per cycle over six cycles following implementation of re-sequenced valuation jobs, as recorded against the platform's published baseline of 9 overruns per cycle.
professionalSummary.witness: Month-end batch overruns fell from 9 per cycle to 2 per cycle over the six cycles after the re-sequenced valuation jobs went live, as recorded in the platform's overrun report against its published baseline of 9 overruns per cycle for the preceding half-year.

professionalSummary.text: Coordinates capacity changes with platform and finance teams in monthly capacity reviews, with platform manager approval for reservations and finance sign-off for cost impact.
professionalSummary.witness: Coordinated capacity changes with the platform and finance teams in the monthly capacity review; reservation changes were approved by the platform manager and the cost impact was signed off by finance.

professionalSummary.text: Documents model assumptions, limitations, and hand-over conditions for each planning cycle in the assumptions note.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote the assumptions note for each planning cycle, listing the model coefficients, the known limitation that ad-hoc adviser reports were outside the forecast and the hand-over items for the next cycle.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Overrun report extract for six cycles showing overruns per cycle, baseline line, and go-live marker for re-sequenced jobs, with report export identifiers as verification trail.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the overrun report extract for the six cycles (overruns per cycle, baseline line, go-live marker for the re-sequenced jobs) and the assumptions note for one cycle, with the report's export identifiers as a verification trail.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's direct involvement in maintaining the demand model, planning capacity, reducing overruns, coordinating with teams, and documenting assumptions. The materials do not establish the candidate's ownership of the re-sequencing proposal, the duration of the six cycles, or the baseline definition beyond the published baseline of 9 overruns per cycle.

evidence.notes: Directly states reduction in overruns against published baseline.

evidence.text: confirmed the overrun figures come from the platform's monthly overrun report, that the re-sequencing of valuation jobs was the candidate's proposal, and the employment dates.

evidence.text: Coordinated capacity changes with the platform and finance teams in the monthly capacity review; reservation changes were approved by the platform manager and the cost impact was signed off by finance.

evidence.text: Wrote the assumptions note for each planning cycle, listing the model coefficients, the known limitation that ad-hoc adviser reports were outside the forecast and the hand-over items for the next cycle.
evidence.notes: Directly states documentation of assumptions, limitations, and hand-over items.
